newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO to hold power-buying tender.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO to hold power-buying tender.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co (TEPCO) said on Tuesday it would hold a tender to buy one million kilowatts (kw) of electricity on a wholesale basis for fiscal 2002/03 and 2003/04.
The tender opens on April 16 and closes on September 11, a TEPCO spokesman said.
Winners will conclude contracts with TEPCO by the end of January 1998.
Utilities held their first buying tenders last year, following industry deregulation in December 1995, which opened the business to independent power producers.
Seven of Japan's 10 electricity utilities plan to hold tenders this year to buy a combined 2.86 million kw of electricity from independent power producers.
